That trace is pointing pretty hard at two hot spots: repeated `pack_full_generation` work and `flush_main` writes inside `process_checkpoints`. I’ll follow those names through the migration path first, then we can make the smallest change that cuts repeated Git/object work instead of just sprinkling timers.

input.cmd: rg -n "checkpoints v2|checkpoint v2|v2" cmd/entire/cli/strategy cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint cmd/entire/cli -g '*.go'

content.text: I found the migration implementation in `cmd/entire/cli/migrate.go`, and the timings already look instrumented around the suspected costly calls. I’m also checking whether this repo has the requested `go:discover-related` helper wired up before I touch Go code, since the local instructions call that out.
